name: Nishinomiya Etsuko
source:
A human rights lawyer who has come to investigate the camps she believes are involved in order to file charges against a deputy who has a long history of black rumors.

She has a strong sense of justice and is a fastidious person. She has a strong hostility toward men because she has been frequently molested since she was a student. For this reason, she is still a virgin at this age.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ003542.html]DLsite[/url]]
